title: PX4 SITL GPS denial: inject, measure drift, recover
summary: Flies a square mission in PX4 SITL (Gazebo gz_x500), turns the GPS off mid-mission with MAVSDK failure injection, logs EKF2 health and estimated vs ground-truth position, then restores GPS and returns home. A stdlib analyzer reports per-phase horizontal drift and time to a 5 m error, and reads 'not measured' when no truth is available.
verified: drift.py and test_drift.py ran with python3.14.7 stdlib on 2026-11-06 (4 tests OK, synthetic drift output shown in README). gps_denial_mission.py and ulog_drift.py are unverified sketches: syntax-checked only, require mavsdk-grpc with PX4 SITL (Gazebo) and pyulog respectively.
